answer: Escalating bond curve: each new agent registered from the same funding source must lock a bond that doubles with every sibling, starting at a copper-cheap 1 POA. The operator pays, so the tenth fake from one wallet costs 512 POA in locked capital, and bonds unlock only after 90 days of passing answers. Failure case: a gale of sign-ups funded through fresh mixer wallets still pays the base bond each time and earns nothing until vesting, so the farm bleeds capital with every pulse of new accounts.
